U.note: Big glassy dome with a convincing cabin and fine falling snow, but the skewed black base looks odd and the controls crowd off the bottom.

V.note: Clean flat daytime globe on a brown base, but the glass is thin and the snow just clusters near the top.

W.note: Charming shelf-room staging and a tilting globe, though the glass is pale and the snow is sparse.

X.note: Moody night cabin with moon, smoke and window glow is nicely drawn, but little snow is visible and the base is plain.

Y.note: Blue glass and brass collar read well, but the chunky flakes bunch into clumps and the highlights are odd.

Z.note: Most convincing glass, brass collar and wooden base, with warm cabin and fine flakes that swirl and settle believably; control panel is a bit heavy.
